# You're Not Newsworthy!

News flash: you're not actually that interesting. Now you can fix that.

Generate realistic-looking fake news articles in six different editorial styles — broadsheet, TV news, breaking news, tech blog, magazine, and newspaper — and share them with the world.

## How to use it

1. Go to [ynn.vercel.app](https://ynn.vercel.app)
2. Fill in the fields (title, article body, photo, author, date, and template style)
3. Hit **Generate**
4. Share the link — everything is encoded in the URL, no server required

## Templates

| Style | Description |
|---|---|
| **Classic** | Broadsheet newspaper — The Chronicle |
| **YNN** | TV cable news with live ticker |
| **Breaking News** | CNN-style with sidebar and lower-third ticker |
| **YNN Times** | Two-column broadsheet with drop cap |
| **Tech** | Dark tech blog with monospace code aesthetic |
| **Magazine** | Premium long-form magazine with pull quote |

## Tech stack

Built with Next.js, TypeScript, Bootstrap 5, and Tailwind CSS. Articles are stateless — the entire article is base64-encoded in the URL.

Part of the [(de)Motivator](https://github.com/rpmul/deMotivator) project family.
